BLOK.description: Base CTD profile sampling interval used in upper

PB1.description: Number of CTD targets in upper

PB2.description: Number of CTD targets in mid

Cyc0.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 0

Cyc1.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 1

Cyc2.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 2

Tlast0.description: pumping to target profile pressure in subcycle 0

Tlast1.description: pumping to target profile pressure in subcycle 1

Tlast2.description: pumping to target profile pressure in subcycle 2

Clast0.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 0

Clast1.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 1

Clast2.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 2

ccPro0.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 0

ccPro1.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 1

ccPro2.description: cc to pump to be neutral at profile pressure in subcycle 2

ccPrk0.description: cc to pump to be neutral at drift pressure in subcycle 0

ccPrk1.description: cc to pump to be neutral at drift pressure in subcycle 1

ccPrk2.description: cc to pump to be neutral at drift pressure in subcycle 2

Rise0.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 0

Rise1.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 1

Rise2.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 2

Fall0.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 0

Fall1.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 1

Fall2.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 2

SAMmn0.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 0

SAMmn1.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 1

SAMmn2.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 2

Nsam0.description: Number of drift samples in subcycle 0

Nsam1.description: Number of drift samples to subcycle 1

Nsam2.description: Number of drift samples to subcycle 2

PmpPrk.description: Time of buoyancy pump at start of ascending profile

MxHiP.description: Max sec to run pump over the full cycle

MnSfP.description: Min sec to run pump @ surface

MxSfP.description: Max time to pump at the surface

mxSeek.description: max pump time for 1 seek cycle

Nseek.description: Number of seek periods targeting drift pressure

STLmin.description: Time to allow float to settle at drift pressure after seek pump

OILvac.description: Max vacuum on oil feed line

dDdV2.description: pump volume to stop with an ascent rate of 1 cm/s

Ventsc.description: Max time[s] to run the air vent

Ventop.description: =0 do nothing,=1 report LLD output,=2 run vent

SkSLsc.description: Time between descending P, time pairs

AsSLsc.description: Time between ascending P, time pairs and ascent rate estimation

Ndives.description: Total number of dives over the mission

UBZmax.description: Depth to start sending raw scans

DrfDat.description: Enable collection of data at drift

dZ_0.description: Sample CTD interval between Z_C2D and Z_DP_1

dZ_1.description: Sample CTD interval between Z_DP_1 and Z_DP_2

dZ_2.description: Sample CTD interval between Z_DP_2 and Z_DP_3

dZ_3.description: Sample CTD interval between Z_DP_3 and Z_DP_4

dZ_4.description: Sample CTD interval between Z_DP_4 and maximum depth

Z_C2D.description: Depth at which to transition from continuous to discrete sampling during descent

Z_D2C.description: Depth at which to transition from discrete to continuous sampling during ascent

PTS_T0.description: Seconds to run SBE pump in descending profile discrete samples in region 0 (Z_C2D & Z_DP_1)

PTS_T1.description: Seconds to run SBE pump in descending profile discrete samples in region 1 (Z_DP_1 & Z_DP_2)

PTS_T2.description: Seconds to run SBE pump in descending profile discrete samples in region 2 (Z_DP_2 & Z_DP_3)

PTS_T3.description: Seconds to run SBE pump in descending profile discrete samples in region 3 (Z_DP_3 & Z_DP_4)

PTS_T4.description: Seconds to run SBE pump in descending profile discrete samples in region 4 (Z_DP_4 & maximum depth)

dT_CP.description: Delay to start profile @ start of descent

dT_DP.description: Max time between descent discrete CTD scans

T_WAIT.description: Minutes to wait @ surface for a command

FP_CHK.description: Descent discrete mode: sample P every FP_CHK seconds

dT_PMP.description: cm^3 to subtract from last ccPro for faster fall rate

Z_dPMP.description: Depth to do the first pump on descent

MAX_XL.description: Maximum vertical velocity increase allowed on descent

CC_km.description: Pump rate loss per km depth

ZN_CF.description: Weighting factor for pump targeting learning of Z_Neu

Z_Neu.description: Netral depth with NO oil in the external bladder

CCC_CF.description: Weighting factor for pump targeting learning of ccCOR

ccCOR.description: adjustment of cm^3 of oil pumped at the netral depth

WDhour.description: Hours with lack of action by the float after which the Watch Dog will be engaged

IceIn.description: Number of true ice-algorithm cycle prior to fully entering icemode

IceOut.description: Number of false ice-algorithm cycles prior to exiting full icemode

PrkMin.description: Minimum pressure above deepest profile pressure to set Park

AZ1.description: Ascending profile upper transition pressure in discrete sampling mode

AZ2.description: Ascending profile mid transition pressure in discrete sampling mode

AZ3.description: Ascending profile lower transition pressure in discrete sampling mode

Adz_1.description: Ascending profile upper sampling resolution while in discrete sampling mode

Adz_2.description: Ascending profile mid sampling resolution while in discrete sampling mode

Adz_3.description: Ascending profile lower sampling resolution while in discrete sampling mode

AT1.description: Seconds to run SBE pump within the ascending profile upper sampling region while in discrete sampling mode

AT2.description: Seconds to run SBE pump within the ascending profile mid sampling region while in discrete sampling mode

AT3.description: Seconds to run SBE pump within the ascending profile lower sampling region while in discrete sampling mode

ptRise.description: Decimation of the ascending target depths to include within the Rise Engineering timeseries

ptFall.description: Decimation of the descending target depths to include within the Fall Engineering timeseries

tmTurn.description: Time allowed for rise during the turn around to park pressure

tmChk.description: Time to check pressure during the turn around to park pressure

DiveNo.description: Integer to start incrementing cycle number
